QuestInfo.name: Worn Bandages
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p412# of #m10003004# has a new favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: #p412# knew full well she wasn't among the living anymore, and yet she refused to accept it. Worried that Dr. Niora might never come back, she said she'd have to change her own bandages, and asked me to defeat #r#o32##k and gather #b#t4000028##k for her. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I gathered #t4000028#s for #p412#. I only wish she hadn't asked me to help her change those bandages..

0.0: Ah, you're #h0#... you came to see me. I'm so happy. I've been waiting here for Dr. Niora this whole time, but I've started to think that maybe he's not coming back after all. I really need my bandages changed, it's a big problem...
0.1: Wh-what...? Why are you looking at me like that? Are you trying to tell me I'm a ghost too? I know I don't show up in the mirror, but maybe the mirror's just broken. Because I can still feel pain where the surgery was. There's no mistaking it.
0.2: So, anyway, I really think I need to change these bandages. If Dr. Niora isn't here, I suppose I'll just have to do it myself. But it seems there aren't any clean bandages left in this hospital... would you mind helping me out?

yes.0: Thank you. Please defeat #r#o32#s#k down in this city's underground and gather #b#t4000028#s#k for me. If I just had that, I think I could manage to change the bandages myself. I'll be waiting right here.

no.0: That's cruel. There's no one else who can help me but you...

1.0: Oh, you're back! These are definitely #t4000028#s...! Ah, I'm so happy. To think I can finally change my bandages...!

item.0: Dr. Niora might never come back. If that's how it is, please defeat #r#o32#s#k down in this city's underground and gather #b#t4000028#s#k so I can change my own bandages. I'm asking you, please...
